meta.label: EXAMPLE DATA — two fictional private buildings seeded from Francesco's two real repair stories (stuck hot-water tap, broken floor). Names, numbers, dates, certificates, registration numbers and slots are invented for the demo. Also includes short excerpts from Dwelly's synthetic letting-agency cases (Dwelly cases 002, 037, 022). Names and ZZ-postcode addresses are as supplied in the hackathon pack. Referenced photos/invoices in those histories were unavailable in the download. Original channels were email/SMS/call — the demo intake channel is WhatsApp. Also a labelled demo replay of Cortile ticket tkt_000096 on Gorse House unit 103 (no leaseholder names).
